title: documentation: list community widgets
body:
As proposed by multiple people and namely @seafoox, I am convinced we should now add a "community widgets" documentation section with the google maps and (maybe) the custom jquery slider example (if it really makes sense).

It should go in last position of the documentation, so that people do stumble on it if they are looking for it.

comments.body: Agreed, with a "want to add your own?" link that points to a small getting started guide.
Maybe have a dedicated page for community widgets? With big warnings and all? :)
To explain that we do not do support on them :)
